messages:
support-alex: Hey team, customer Acme reporting big latency regressions after a config push this morning — p99 jumped from ~120ms to ~1.6s and a few 504s since ~10:05 UTC. They attached a few request ids. Can someone triage?

oncall_bot: [ALERT] p99 latency spike detected for model 'igpt-3.5-q8' on region-us-west-2. metric: inference.p99 = 1600ms, host: gpu-12. Alert started at 10:07 UTC.

maria: looking now. pulling traces and batcher metrics from 09:50-10:20.

chen: quick note — there was a throughput experiment rolled out at 09:58 that bumped continuous-batcher min_wait_ms from 5 -> 30ms and increased max_batch_size from 64 -> 96 on that model. rollout was targeted but maybe hit Acme's tenant.

juno: can we confirm whether tiny-prompt traffic increased? tiny prompts + higher min_wait often amplifies hold-time tail.

maria: traces show a lot of tiny requests (<8 tokens) queued for ~250-1200ms waiting to fill batch. KV cache hits ok. The runtime is batching many tiny reqs because of increased min_wait. Example span: 
```
batch_hold_time_ms=840, batch_size=18, prompt_tokens=6, tenant=acme
```

chen: that lines up. small inputs shouldn't be coalesced that long. rollout spec: 
```
continuous_batcher:
  min_wait_ms: 30
  max_batch_size: 96
  cohorting: enabled
```

support-alex: Acme says they saw the jump right after 09:58 and they started routing some traffic to fallback endpoint (higher cost) but need a fix.

juno: mitigation options: rollback min_wait to 5ms (fast), or enable tenant fastpath (force_single_batch=true) for Acme only. I'd prefer targeted fastpath while we validate rollback.

maria: I can do a quick rollback of the experiment for that model in us-west-2. Patching config now.

maria: PATCH applied at 10:20 UTC — min_wait_ms -> 5, max_batch_size -> 64 for igpt-3.5-q8 in region-us-west-2.

chen: running smoke repro in staging to confirm. repro script (parallel tiny requests): 
```
for i in {1..200}; do 
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -d '{"model":"igpt-3.5-q8","input":"hi","max_tokens":2}' &
done; wait
```

maria: metrics after rollback: within 5 minutes p99 dropped from ~1600ms -> ~240ms, p95 down to ~82ms. Acme support just posted they see substantial improvement.

support-alex: confirming — Acme reports latency back to normalish, still seeing rare spikes ~350ms. They appreciate the fast turnaround. :thumbsup:

juno: follow-ups: 1) We need a canary plan for min_wait experiments that excludes tiny-prompt-heavy tenants. 2) Add a tiny-prompt cohort fastpath that bypasses coalescing if avg_tokens < 12. 3) Postmortem + config rollout rollback checklist.

chen: opened ticket INF-8721 to track root cause and safe rollout gating. I'll add the experiment timeline and cohort distribution graphs.

maria: repro steps and patch recorded in the ticket. Also added a dashboard alert for batch_hold_time_95pct > 200ms to trigger earlier.

juno: temporary config change idea (per-tenant) — set `coalesce_threshold_tokens: 12` and `force_single_for_tiny: true` for Acme as a targeted mitigation while we design adaptive logic.

maria: logged that in INF-8721. We should also add a small unit test in the batcher e2e harness that simulates a burst of tiny prompts to detect regressions.

support-alex: I'll follow up with the customer and close the escalation once we confirm stability for 24h.

oncall_bot: [NOTE] Incident tagged INF-8721, severity: P2, assignees: maria, chen, juno.

maria: thanks everyone. marking this thread for postmortem notes.
